```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    # Run every 6 hours
    - cron: "0 */6 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: airbyte

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Sync docs
        id: sync-docs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          SRC_DIR="airbyte-ai-connectors/docs/connectors"
          DEST_DIR="airbyte/docs/ai-agents/connectors"

          # Create destination directory
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

          # Remove existing files to ensure clean sync
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"/*

          # Copy all markdown files from each connector directory
          find "$SRC_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec basename {} \; | while read -r connector_dir; do
            echo "Processing connector: $connector_dir"
            src_connector_path="$SRC_DIR/$connector_dir"
            dest_connector_path="$DEST_DIR/$connector_dir"
            
            # Create destination connector directory
            mkdir -p "$dest_connector_path"
            
            # Copy all markdown files from source to destination
            find "$src_connector_path" -name "*.md" -exec cp {} "$dest_connector_path/" \;
          done

          # Check if there are any changes
          if [[ -z "$(git -C airbyte status --porcelain)" ]]; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            echo "changes_detected=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "Changes detected"
            echo "changes_detected=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.sync-docs.outputs.changes_detected == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          path: airbyte
          commit-message: "docs: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          title: "docs: sync AI connector docs from airbyte-ai-connectors"
          body: |
            This PR syncs AI connector documentation from the `airbyte-ai-connectors` repository.
            
            Auto-generated by GitHub Actions workflow.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          delete-branch: true
          labels: |
            documentation
            auto-merge
```
